interface.longDescription: Deterministically query 78 public scientific, biomedical, materials science, regulatory, finance, and demographics databases through documented REST APIs. Use for reproducible lookups of compounds, genes, proteins, pathways, variants, clinical trials, patents, economic indicators, structures, astronomy objects, environmental records, or database-backed scientific facts when endpoints, filters, pagination, and provenance need to be explicit.
